title: Cheesy Bean Pilaf
description: A flavorful pilaf dish with beans, cheese, and a hint of Middle Eastern spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the pilaf spice blend and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Syrian white rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the dried yellow split peas and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the canned beans, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the shredded white cheddar cheese until melted and well combined.
